description: List the files uploaded to the layernote project (images, PDFs and videos) in the order of its Files sidebar: each file with its id, kind, page count or length, and how many open and total comments it has. A file with more than one version is listed once, at its latest version, with its `versions` (each with its own id and counts; comments stay on the version they were made on). Use get_file to look at a file with its open comments pinned on it, compare_versions to check an older version's comments against a newer one, and list_feedback with `file` for the comments themselves. On a Figma design project it lists the frames instead, in the order of its Frames sidebar: pictures of the design’s screens, marked `figma`, that get_file, add_comments and show_file take like files (a frame marked `rendering` has no picture yet). A website project has no files.
